intro: Follow how a text links ideas and how later phrases refer back to earlier information.
b1.titulo: Follow the thread of the text
b1.texto: Connectors show relations between ideas: **porque** gives a reason, **por ello** introduces a result and **a pesar de** marks a concession. A noun phrase such as **esa iniciativa** can refer to an idea mentioned earlier. To understand a paragraph, ask both how its sentences connect and what each reference points to.
b2.f0: Last year, several residents turned an empty plot into a community garden.
b2.f1: The initiative began with six families, but now two neighbourhood schools also take part.
b2.f2: Although the space is small, the people who look after it have planted herbs, tomatoes and flowers for insects.
b2.f3: For that reason, the group has asked the council for a water tap and a cupboard for tools.
b2.f4: That request has not yet been approved. Meanwhile, participants bring water from home and organise maintenance shifts.
b2.f5: In addition, one of the schools holds science workshops in the garden and takes its classes there once a month.
b2.f6: The organisers hope that this collaboration will continue through the summer, although they have not yet decided who will water the plants.
b2.f7: The project does not produce enough food for the whole neighbourhood; even so, its organisers think it is worthwhile because of the activities and participation it creates.
